title: Inverted error handling logic
detail: The new condition clears the error unless `error` is not None, `self.should_ignore_error` is not None, and `self.should_ignore_error(error)` returns True. This is the opposite of the intended behavior, which should only clear the error when `should_ignore_error` returns True. With `should_ignore_error` set to None (the deprecation path), the error is always cleared, breaking error propagation.
note: Describes the planted negation of the ignore-error condition.
